title: governance.disposition_stale.v1
description: Integration-contract v1 for the DispositionStale event (GOV-14b / EDR-GOVERNANCE-01 D14). A suppressing decision's premise has drifted and the Finding should be looked at again. It is a completed FACT, not a state change: the Position named here is untouched and remains in force until a human or a governed policy revises it.

Stance.description: The suppressing stance still in force. This event does not change it.

Reason.description: What actually moved, in words — 'EPSS 3% -> 71%' earns a second look where 'signals changed' does not.
